FishRight
0510
Scores are a guide built from forecasts, not a promise of fish. Not for navigation. Harbour seafood advice: don’t eat fish caught west of the Harbour Bridge, and limit fish caught east of it. Check rules, size and bag limits with NSW DPI Fisheries. Weather & sea temperature: Open-Meteo (DWD and partners). Tides: harmonic prediction from Fort Denison gauge data (UHSLC). Shorelines © OpenStreetMap contributors. Base maps © Esri and contributors, OpenStreetMap. Depths: NSW DCCEEW marine LiDAR & multibeam bathymetry.
